referents.why: 'this is the finger of God': the demonstrative refers to the gnats just produced, which is not among the candidates. The feminine pronoun agrees with the predicate 'finger' (copula use), so the finger is not its referent.
referents.category: demonstrative whose referent is not a candidate

referents.why: 'he did not listen to them': the them are the magicians who had spoken; masculine plural agrees.
the one who does not listen is a person, Pharaoh; the heart (w11) is what was hardened, not the listener. The act decides, so the builder's heart is replaced.

links.why: cl0 is the magicians' speech frame and comes before cl2 and cl3; the refusal is not a sequence after the frame.
waw joining the hardening of the heart and the refusal; the conjunction supports it.
cl1 is inside the magicians' speech; the narrative line continues from the speech frame cl0, which is the nearest clause not inside a speech.
ka'asher 'just as' before a clause nested in cl3's prepositional role: as the LORD had said.
the magicians say; what is said is the clause 'this is the finger of God' (R1).
wayehezaq continues the narrative line after the speech frame, which is the nearest clause before it not inside a speech.

groups.why: the magicians speak to Pharaoh; cl1 is the part said.
